svg.aria-label: SyncLane's architecture: the PostgreSQL schema with its tables and indexes, the engine's subsystems inside your application, the declarative HTTP source, their APIs, your tables, and the guarantees.
svg.title: How SyncLane is built
svg.text: A .NET library inside your process. One PostgreSQL schema holds every job, budget and decision.
one schema, created at start-up or by script
one row per job: everything about it
how far each owner's data reaches
names and values, one row each
tokens and pause streak per key
what is stopped, until when, why
who did what to which job, and why
same call, same rows: added once
a fresh DI scope for every page
every write fenced by the lease
attempts count from the last page
a token bucket per account, a row
a 429 pauses it on every instance
LISTEN wakes idle slots at once
polls every 5 s when it can't
gone after 2 min, kept for a day
from your ICredentialStore; a 401 renews once
before every request, on every instance
no redirects; a key in the URL is
stripped before it becomes a cursor
the next page stays on the same host
upserts: a page may arrive twice
init · test · mcp: a curl → a recipe
WHAT IT PROMISES, AND WHAT MAKES IT TRUE
a unique index, not a lock:
the cursor is on the row;
